en: A black-and-white postcard image showing a large wooden building and a more modern adjacent structure. In the foreground is a tall flagpole with the Norwegian flag. There are trees and a dirt path leading to the building. The text at the bottom identifies the place as 'Grando Rekreasjonshjem, Nes, Hedmark.' The image has a vintage feel, suggesting it is from the early to mid-20th century.
